topic: What would happen if you lived inside GTA 6 for 24 hours?
angle: GTA 6 comes out on November 19, 2026: Max wakes up inside a GTA-style neon Florida city and has to survive 24 hours with game logic in real life (wanted stars, cars, ragdoll physics, respawning). Funny and science-based: what would really happen to a human body and to a city if game rules were real.
notes: Release-day hook: open with 'GTA 6 just came out... so what if you had to LIVE in it for 24 hours?'. Say 'GTA 6' in the first sentence (it is what people search today).
Keep it family friendly: chases, crashes, wild physics, 5-star wanted level, insane stunts. No shooting people, no killing, no drugs.

IMAGE PROMPTS: never write 'GTA', 'Grand Theft Auto', 'Rockstar' or game character names (Jason, Lucia) and never draw logos, game HUD screenshots or real game characters. Describe an ORIGINAL sunny neon Miami-like coastal city with palm trees, sports cars, police cars and beaches, video-game vibe.
Use real science for each consequence (g-forces in crashes, falling from buildings, how fast police respond, how long a body can go without sleep).
